text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka was able to successfully 
complete her debut race.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fufu... No.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I feel like something even more incredible 
is waiting for us down the road.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I... want to see that.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "Together"...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
No... you're right. After all, we're two 
peas in a pod...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Still, it feels kind of strange...
choice_data_list: It'll become second nature in no time.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...I hope it turns out that way.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
After all, we're going to enter so many 
races together from now on...
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's do our best together!
Yeah, let's do our best together!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"The pleasure is mine... Um, I look 
forward to working with you, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Suzuka-saaaan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on your debut~! You were 
sooo cool!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Geez, Spe-chan, really...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hello! You're Suzuka-san's Trainer, 
right?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm Special Week, her roommate! I've heard 
all about you from Suzuka-san!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That they're a kind person who wouldn't 
deny Suzuka-san's ideals!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh!? I didn't say it like that...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sorry! But it went pretty much like 
that, right?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"That might've been true for the most 
part... but still...!"

“—At any rate, the days of pushing toward 
the limits together with a girl who loves 
running have begun.”

To help her reach the stage she strives 
for, I want her to take on many more 
races—!
